title: Client Rollout Milestone Dashboard — QBR Draft
content:
Purpose:
This is a working snapshot (QBR-ready draft) of a customer-specific rollout milestone dashboard and playbook. Designed for CS managers and SEs to use in quarterly business reviews and renewal conversations. Focus: inference rollouts (hosted/dedicated/private).

How to use this doc:
- Use as a concise one-page status for stakeholders; expand the action items section into Jira tickets (link above).
- Keep this doc attached to the QBR slide deck as the operational appendix.
- Update at least weekly and before any exec-facing meeting.

Key constraints and assumptions:
- Dates are target-oriented; engineering dates are estimates unless marked "committed" by ENG PM.
- Owner means the primary CS/SE owner; engineering owners are called out in blockers where relevant.
- Renewal signal: renewal conversations should begin once "Pilot success" metrics are green for >=2 weeks or when usage > 50% of committed Dedicated capacity.

One-line summary for QBR header:
Customer: Acme BioApps — Inference rollout in pilot (gen-omics-v2) across hosted -> dedicated. Risk: Medium (KV-cache tuning + network egress performance). Renewal window: 60 days.

Milestone tracker (high-level):
- Onboarding kickoff: Owner: Leah Kim — Target: 2024-09-10 — Status: complete
- Data ingress validation (SFTP -> Redwood sandbox): Owner: Ethan Moore — Target: 2024-09-20 — Status: complete
- Baseline evals (latency/cost/quality): Owner: Ravi Patel — Target: 2024-10-01 — Status: complete — Notes: baseline model latency 85ms p50, p95 220ms (seq len 512)
- Pilot deploy (1 shard, hosted): Owner: Sofia Alvarez — Target: 2024-10-15 — Status: complete — Notes: KV cache enabled; observed 24% token cost reduction
- Load test (simulated 200 TPS): Owner: Jordan Blake — Target: 2024-11-01 — Status: in_progress — Blockers: infra autoscale race condition (infra ticket INS-88)
- Dedicated capacity onboarding (reserved pool): Owner: Leah Kim — Target: 2024-12-01 — Status: at_risk — Blockers: procurement SLA negotiation; infra capacity quota
- Canary rollout (10% traffic on Dedicated): Owner: Ethan Moore — Target: 2025-01-05 — Status: planned
- Pilot success signoff (CS + Eng QA): Owner: Ravi Patel — Target: 2025-01-20 — Status: planned — Success criteria: error rate <0.5%, latency p95 <300ms, cost per 1k tokens within 10% of forecast, no regression in quality evals

Blockers and mitigations (current):
- INS-88 (autoscale race): summary: during 200 TPS load test autoscaler failed to attach extra inference pods quickly; symptom: burst-induced 503s for ~30s.
  - Mitigation: SRE/infra patch in testing, temporary throttle on client side to smooth ramp (CS recommended throttling config in SDK).
  - Owners: Jordan Blake (CS), Priya Desai (SRE).
  - Impact on timeline: pushes Dedicated onboarding ~2–3 weeks unless quota bump approved.

- Procurement SLA negotiation: enterprise legal requires a custom data processing addendum; procurement has signoff dependencies.
  - Mitigation: escalate to enterprise sales lead (cc: Hannah Ortiz), provide template DPA and self-host option pricing.
  - Owner: Leah Kim (CS), Sales: Miguel Santos.

Risk register (quick):
- High: Procurement/legal delays -> impacts renewal timing.
- Medium: Autoscale instability under burst traffic -> impacts canary and confidence for Dedicated commit.
- Low: Slight model quality drift observed on 2 prompts; fixed by small prompt engineering changes; tracked in GH-PR-2894.

Renewal and QBR talking points (playbook):
- Start renewal outreach when Pilot success metrics met for 2 consecutive weeks or 60 days before contract end.
- Pre-QBR checklist for CS owner:
  - Validate that baseline and pilot evals are attached to the QBR packet (links to eval artifacts).
  - Confirm infra tickets status and mitigation timeline (INS-88, capacity quota).
  - Prepare a cost delta slide showing current per-1k token cost vs forecast + recommended Optimize settings (batching, caching).
  - Draft optional commercial concession: 3-month discounted Dedicated trial if procurement delays cause >30 day slip.

Escalation playbook (when to escalate and to whom):
- Day 0–7 blocker: CS owner and SE to triage; open/update infra ticket; daily standup until resolved.
- Day 7–21: escalate to SRE manager and Product PM; schedule 1:1 deep dive; propose temporary fallbacks (reduce concurrency, sticky routing to hosted pool).
- >21 days (production-impacting): involve Sales leadership + Legal for mitigation/contract amendment conversation.

Operational runbook snippets (quick configs):
- Suggested SDK throttling: maxConcurrency: 50, tokenBurstWindowMs: 2000 (customer-specific; tune during load tests).
- KV-cache TTL guidance: 24h for prompt prefixes that are mostly static; 0s for highly dynamic user-provided context.
- Canary rollback criteria: >1% user-facing errors OR sustained p95 latency growth >20% over baseline for 10m window.

QBR appendix (metrics to include):
- Adoption: active users, requests/day, host/session growth week-over-week
- Reliability: error rate, p50/p95 latency, duration of incidents, MTTR
- Cost: tokens per request, cost per 1k tokens, estimated monthly spend vs committed
- Quality: pass rate on golden prompts, human-eval score delta month-over-month

Open questions / notes to self (to resolve before final QBR):
- Confirm whether Acme will accept Redwood-managed KMS or requires HSM for Private deployment. (Action: Leah to confirm with customer legal)
- Decide which evaluation prompt set is canonical for renewal success (prod vs synthetic). (Action: Ravi to propose final set)
- If procurement stalls, what is the approved concession budget? (Action: Sales to confirm)

Action items (next 7 days):
- Jordan: complete post-load-test log analysis and attach summary to INS-88 (due 2024-12-09).
- Leah: follow up with procurement and escalate to sales lead if no response in 3 business days (due 2024-12-06).
- Ravi: finalize golden prompt set and publish eval run (due 2024-12-10).
- Sohail (Engineering): provide ETA for autoscaler patch and short description of rollback mechanism (due 2024-12-08).

Appendix — quick links and artifacts referenced:
- Load test artifact: /artifacts/load-tests/acme-2024-11-01 (internal)
- INS-88 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INS-88
- Eval runs: GH-PR-2894 and Confluence eval page (see linked_artifacts)

Notes and tone: this document is intentionally terse; the goal is a readable one-pager to hand to execs with an operational appendix. Keep updates minimal and date-stamped.

Unresolved: legal DPA wording; ensure we have a fallback commercial offer for procurement stalls.

Document history: draft created by Ravi Patel 2024-11-20; collaborative edits through 2024-12-05.
